explicit_nonclaims: No claim that the LHC is a nuclear explosion or performs the same process as neutron irradiation of bulk matter.
No claim that CERN routinely collides gold beams at the LHC.
No claim that quark-gluon plasma is literal philosophical chaos or the Big Bang itself.
No claim that human consciousness physically creates LHC collision products.
No claim that crude oil and glucose spontaneously form a surfactant.
No claim that heating, radiation or shock guarantees useful hybrid molecules.
No claim that Friedel-Crafts chemistry directly converts crude oil plus glucose into a detergent.
No claim that an emulsion proves synthesis of an amphiphile.
No claim that all glucose-based surfactants are harmless, fully renewable or sustainable.
No operational chemical recipe, hazardous irradiation procedure or industrial scale-up instruction.
No claim that chemical bridging provides a complete model of human relationships.
allowed_claim_classes: positive design principles without hazardous procedures
